content.title: Stocks Sail Past Jobs Data, Tariff Opinion Delay. Earnings Season Looms.
content.summary: Investors navigated two key near-term risks Friday, including a mixed report on the domestic job market and the likely delay of a Supreme Court ruling on tariffs.  Employers added a net new 50,000 jobs to the economy last month, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.  It’s a smaller tally than forecast by Wall Street but still a positive reading for a weakening labor market that has added the fewest new hires since 2003 over the past year.
